title: 第5章 叶倾城的心事第6章 北荒城古怪玉佛
content_zh:
叶家。
一座精致的小院内。
叶倾城站在院子之中，身上依旧是凤披霞冠，但此刻看着夜空中皎洁的圆月，微微失神。
“小姐，你明明心中有姑爷，为何对他如此冷漠呀？”
叶倾城的身后，兰香忍不住问道。
从苏尘的卧室出来之后，叶倾城就是这么一副失魂落魄的样子，让她无比的心疼自家小姐。
“你……胡说，谁……心中有他了！”
冷不丁的听到兰香的话，叶倾城顿时脸色羞红，结结巴巴的说道。
“小姐，你瞒得过别人，可瞒不过我！
这几年，你一直明里暗里的搜集苏尘公子的消息，尤其是半月前，苏尘公子修炼走火入魔，丹田被毁，沦为废人的消息传来，你更是数夜无眠！
这还叫心中没有姑爷？不过兰香好奇的是，您耗费了那么大的代价，甚至不惜将家中的极品宝药七叶紫参拿去苏家，换苏尘公子入赘叶家，如今您和姑爷成亲了，又为何对他如此冷漠？”
兰香眨巴着可爱的大眼睛，十分好奇的问道。
“为何对他冷漠？实在是……不得不如此！”
叶倾城轻叹了一声道。
“你应该知道我如今的处境，家族之中很多人对我不满，认为我无法修炼，却占据少族长之位，德不配位，若我对他太过亲近，势必会让他卷入漩涡，无比的危险！
所以……”
叶倾城的声音有些苦涩。
“他们胡说八道！”
兰香愤愤不平的说道：“小姐，若是没有你这些年执掌叶家，经营商业，竭尽心力，叶家也不可能如此强盛！
叶家的那些人，都是一群忘恩负义之辈吗？”

叶家原本不过是北荒城的二流家族。
但叶倾城却是商业奇才，这些年经营家族各项产业，开源节流，赚取了海量的灵石和修炼资源，才让叶家一跃成为北荒城的第一家族。
但如今叶家强盛之后，因为叶倾城无法修炼武道，很多人就盯上了叶倾城的少族长之位。
“不管如何，只要能够保护苏尘，即便他对我有所怨恨，也无所谓了！”
叶倾城轻声说道。
她微微有些失神，仿佛又想起了十二岁那年。
大雪纷飞，天寒地冻。
她被人贩子拐卖，流落他乡，深陷绝境，但却被一对父子所救，成了她心中唯一的光。
她还记得那个意气风发的俊朗少年，为她擦拭眼泪，告诉她，不要怕。
他会保护她！
那个少年照亮了她年少岁月的黑暗，成了支撑她活下去的唯一希望，也早已深深的烙印在了她的内心深处。
那个少年，名叫苏尘！
叶倾城纤细的手指，轻轻抚摸着一张有些破旧的手帕，上面绣着一枚造型古朴的戒指。
这是苏尘当年为她擦拭眼泪的手帕。
她珍藏至今，宛如绝世珍宝！
“小姐，只是太委屈你了！”
兰香眼泪汪汪的说道。
“我没事！”
叶倾城微微一笑道。
她的笑容很好看，温婉如水，整个小院仿佛都亮了。

如今，她朝思暮想的那个人就在身边。
以前他是高高在上的九天骄阳，让人仰望，叶倾城只能够凭借着一鳞半爪的消息，聊以自慰。
content_en:
Ye family.
In an exquisite small courtyard.
Ye Qingcheng stood in the courtyard, still wearing a phoenix and a crown of clouds, but looking at the bright full moon in the night sky, she was slightly absent-minded.
"Miss, you clearly have a brother-in-law in your heart, why are you so indifferent to him?"
Behind Ye Qingcheng, Lan Xiang couldn't help but ask.
After coming out of Su Chen's bedroom, Ye Qingcheng looked so lost, which made her feel extremely sorry for her young lady.
"You... are talking nonsense, who... has him in your heart!"
Hearing Lan Xiang's words unexpectedly, Ye Qingcheng's face suddenly turned red and he stammered.
"Miss, you can hide it from others, but you can't hide it from me!
In the past few years, you have been collecting information about Mr. Su Chen overtly and covertly. Especially half a month ago, the news came that Mr. Su Chen went crazy in his cultivation, destroyed his Dantian, and became a cripple. You were even more sleepless for several nights!
Does this mean you don’t have an uncle in your heart? But what Lan Xiang is curious about is that you spent so much money, and even took the top-quality medicine Seven-leaf Purple Ginseng at home to the Su family, and exchanged it for Master Su Chen to marry into the Ye family. Now that you are married to your uncle, why are you so indifferent to him? "
Lan Xiang blinked her cute big eyes and asked curiously.
"Why are you so indifferent to him? It really...has to be like this!"
Ye Qingcheng sighed softly.
"You should know my current situation. Many people in the family are dissatisfied with me. They think that I cannot cultivate, but I occupy the position of the young patriarch. My virtue is not worthy of my position. If I get too close to him, he will inevitably be involved in the whirlpool, which is extremely dangerous!
So..."
Ye Qingcheng's voice was a little bitter.
"They're talking nonsense!"
Lan Xiang said angrily: "Miss, without you taking charge of the Ye family, running the business, and doing your best these years, the Ye family would not be so strong!
Are those people in the Ye family a bunch of ungrateful people? "
The Ye family was originally just a second-rate family in Beihuang City.
But Ye Qingcheng is a business wizard. Over the years, he has managed various family industries, increased revenue and reduced expenditure, and earned a large amount of spiritual stones and cultivation resources, which made the Ye family become the first family in Beihuang City.
But now that the Ye family has become stronger, because Ye Qingcheng cannot practice martial arts, many people are eyeing Ye Qingcheng's position as the young patriarch.
"No matter what, as long as I can protect Su Chen, even if he resents me, it doesn't matter!"
Ye Qingcheng said softly.
She was slightly absent-minded, as if she was remembering the time when she was twelve years old.
It's snowing heavily and it's freezing cold.
She was abducted by human traffickers and left in a foreign land, in a desperate situation, but she was rescued by a father and son, who became the only light in her heart.
She still remembered the high-spirited and handsome young man who wiped her tears and told her not to be afraid.
He will protect her!
That boy illuminated the darkness of her youth, became her only hope to survive, and was deeply imprinted in her heart.
That young man’s name is Su Chen!
Ye Qingcheng's slender fingers gently stroked a somewhat worn handkerchief with a simple ring embroidered on it.
This is the handkerchief Su Chen used to wipe her tears.
She has treasured it to this day like a peerless treasure!
"Miss, I just feel so wronged to you!"
Lanxiang said with tears in her eyes.
"I'm fine!"
Ye Qingcheng smiled slightly.
Her smile was beautiful, as gentle as water, and the whole courtyard seemed to light up.
Now, the person she longed for was by her side.
In the past, he was like the blazing sun in the sky, making people look up to him. Ye Qingcheng could only comfort himself with the scraps of news.
